_doc: Run 2 validation, displacement-triggered channel. Matches DVCode's choices closely enough that trigger yields can be compared directly.
_deltas: Relative to dvFull: CHS jets (Run 2 used slimmedJets, not PUPPI); Run 2 electron IDs; DVCode's vertexer track preselection; the b-jet OR displaced-dijet HLT skim.

Jet._note: Run 2 analysis used CHS slimmedJets. slimmedJetsPuppi exists in UL MiniAODv2 but is not what DVCode selected on.

Track._note: DVCode mfvVertexTracks preselection (Vertexer_cfi.py, read 2026-08-25): min_track_pt 1, min_track_npxlayers 2, min_track_nstlayers 6. This is the cut that makes the track table affordable. The dxy-significance cut (min_track_rescaled_sigmadxy 4) is NOT applied - it needs the per-year track rescaling, which is a downstream step.

Electron._note: Winter22 IDs do not exist in Run 2 MiniAOD and electronID() THROWS on an unknown name, so these must be overridden per campaign.

cutBased.doc: cut-based Fall17-94X-V2 ID: 0 fail, 1 veto, 2 loose, 3 medium, 4 tight
